  • Method Details

    • attributes

      @Contract(mutates="this") FeatureFlagService.Factory attributes(Attributes attributes)
      Sets the global targeting attributes for services created by this factory.

      These attributes apply to every flag defined by the service and are merged with any per-flag attributes supplied during definition.

      Parameters:
      attributes - the global targeting attributes
      Returns:
      the feature flag service factory
      Since:
      0.24.0
